title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Huba
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device flowing with flavour with the Huba Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 10ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Huba delivers the timeless taste of classic confectionery in a smooth and aromatic profile. This retro-inspired flavour captures the sugary, distinctive notes of pink Bubblegum, offering a sweet and playful vape without any added fruit or ice. It provides a pure and satisfying confectionery experience that stays consistent from the first puff to the last. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free.
